project.title: Packaging Line Uptime and Food Waste Reduction Initiative
project.objective: Increase uptime and reduce food waste on the main packaging line through targeted maintenance, process tuning, and operator practices.
deliverables: Baseline report on current downtime and food waste on the main packaging line
Preventive maintenance schedule and checklists for critical machinery
Standard operating procedure for start-up, shutdown, and cleaning of the line
Root cause analysis report for top 5 recurring faults
Training session and quick-reference guide for line operators
Final impact report comparing KPIs before and after changes
constraints: All changes must comply with food safety and hygiene legislation and internal GMP
No major equipment replacements; focus on maintenance, settings, and procedures
Minimal production disruption; planned work mainly during scheduled downtimes
All documentation must be clear for shift-based teams and audited by quality
Data collection limited to existing sensors, logs, and manual check sheets

risks.risk: Unplanned breakdowns during the project skew baseline and results
risks.mitigation: Log incidents separately and normalise analysis; adjust scope if needed.

risks.risk: Process changes conflict with food safety or hygiene requirements
risks.mitigation: Review all changes with quality and health and safety before rollout.

risks.risk: Limited access to equipment due to high production demand
risks.mitigation: Coordinate with production supervisor to book maintenance windows early.

risks.risk: Inconsistent adoption of new procedures across shifts
risks.mitigation: Provide simple guides, brief all shifts, and spot-check adherence.

themes.why_relevant: Shifts focus from emergency repairs to planned work that improves uptime.
Any mechanical or process change must not compromise product safety.
Reliable logs are needed to prove impact and prioritise actions.
Multiple shifts must follow the same procedures for stable results.

themes.theme: Root cause analysis of recurring faults
themes.why_relevant: Fixing underlying issues reduces repeated breakdowns and waste.

backlog.task: Map current packaging line, critical machines, and failure history
definition_of_done: List of all key machines with basic specs is documented
Last 3 months of breakdown and fault history are summarised
Top 5 failure modes by frequency and impact are identified

backlog.task: Collect baseline data on downtime and food waste for the line
definition_of_done: All shifts use a simple log for downtime and waste for 7 days
Baseline sheet is completed and validated with production supervisor
Key baseline KPIs are calculated and shared with the team

backlog.task: Design preventive maintenance schedule for critical equipment
definition_of_done: Critical components and recommended service intervals are listed
Draft PM schedule fits existing production calendar
Schedule is reviewed with production supervisor and quality

backlog.task: Create standard operating procedure for line start-up and shutdown
definition_of_done: Current practices from all shifts are collected and compared
SOP draft covers start-up, changeover, shutdown, and cleaning
SOP is approved by quality and shared with all shifts

backlog.task: Develop maintenance and cleaning checklists for the line
definition_of_done: Checklist items for daily, weekly, and monthly tasks are defined
Checklists are tested on at least one full shift
Feedback from operators is incorporated and final version is stored

backlog.task: Perform root cause analysis on top 3 recurring mechanical faults
definition_of_done: Fault logs and operator feedback are collected
Root causes and contributing factors are documented
Agreed corrective actions are listed with owners and timing

backlog.task: Pilot adjusted machine settings to reduce product damage and waste
definition_of_done: Safe parameter ranges are defined with quality approval
Pilot run is executed and monitored for at least one shift
Results show stable operation with equal or lower waste

backlog.task: Standardise operator checks for raw materials and packaging quality
definition_of_done: Key incoming quality checks are defined and documented
Simple visual guide is created for operators
Guide is reviewed by quality and posted at the line

backlog.task: Train operators and mechanics on new procedures and checklists
definition_of_done: Training content is prepared using final SOPs and checklists
At least 2 shifts attend a short briefing session
Attendance is logged and questions are captured for follow-up

backlog.task: Monitor post-implementation performance and compare to baseline
definition_of_done: Downtime and waste data are collected for at least 5 days
KPIs are compared to baseline and summarised in a short report
Remaining issues and next steps are listed for future work

backlog.task: Ensure environmental and waste handling compliance on the line
definition_of_done: Current waste handling practices are reviewed against rules
Any gaps are documented and quick fixes are proposed
Quality and health and safety confirm compliance status

backlog.task: Coordinate project timeline and communication across shifts
definition_of_done: Simple timeline with key activities is shared with all shifts
Slack channel and noticeboard updates are posted as planned
Feedback from at least two shifts is collected and summarised

Twice-weekly short update on downtime and waste numbers in the channel

End-of-week summary post capturing decisions and any SOP or checklist changes
